4966.body:
## Outcome
The Project Overview becomes one column: the Ask bar, then collapsible sections. Owner decisions (shaped 2026-10-29):

1. **Sections:** Needs you, Asks, Reactions and Made are each a collapsible section (disclosure heading) in the Overview, in that order. No section opens as a full-height view, and no "Close Named reactions" or "Close Made" buttons remain. A section's own actions (New reaction, Refresh) sit in its heading row. An empty section shows one quiet line, never a big illustration.
2. **Accordion, attention wins:** opening a section closes the others. On load or Project switch, Needs you opens if it has items. Otherwise the section with the newest unseen item opens; with nothing unseen, all stay closed. Keyboard: the headings are buttons; Return and Space toggle; ↑ and ↓ move between headings.
3. **Unseen indicator:** each section heading shows a small dot while it holds an item the user has not seen. An item counts as seen once its section has been open while the item was on screen. The dot clears then, per Project, and persists across reload.
4. **Rename:** Named reactions becomes **Reactions** in all user labels: menus, heading, empty line, settings. The code term stays as `GLOSSARY.md` has it.
5. **Inbox folds into Needs you:** the Inbox Drawer (`⌘K I`, U3770a–e) is removed. Its grouping by who needs you moves into the Needs you section. `⌘K I` opens the Overview with Needs you open. Retire U3770's Drawer clauses.
6. **Made stays, as a collapsed section:** the DV5 list (publications, filter by Workstream or Agent, Copy Link, Send to Agent) moves into the Made section with the same behaviour.
7. **Bench:** the Shelf's user label "work items" becomes **Bench** ("Open the Bench", "Close the Bench"), with chord `⌘K B` in place of `⌘K S`, checked against `scenarios/ui-shortcuts.md`. The Bench holds the Todos and Pads tabs and leaves room for plugin tabs later. Update the GLOSSARY user label for Shelf.

## Mode
Specify: amend U504, U505, U2539b (`ask-bar.md`, `ui-worktree-changes.md`), U3770a–e (`inbox`), DV5 (Made), the Reactions UI scenarios and the Shelf label scenarios. Keep tests behaviour-only: toggles, accordion, unseen-dot state, key routing. The design critic judges looks. Then edit the dependent implementation Issues' Scenarios lines.

Scenarios: U504 U505 U2539b U3770a DV5
Specification: [scenarios/ask-bar.md](https://github.com/roundup-app/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/ask-bar.md)
Key: overview-sections-spec
Priority: 1
Mode: specify

## Amendment (2026-10-29)
The Reactions section has no New reaction action: Agents create Reactions, and the user asks for one through the Ask bar (see the Agent-first Reactions spec Issue). The section lists Reactions with maker, reason and Stop.

4533.body:
## Outcome

The owner, 2026-10-28: "the scoping of Pads is weird; the user would like to see all the Pads all the time."

The Shelf's Pads tab lists every Pad in the Project, grouped by Workstream and Agent, whatever the Rail selects. The Rail selection no longer filters Pads; its Pads count counts every Pad. Todos keep their current scope.

## Scope

Specification scope also includes `scenarios/ui-shelf-frame.md`, where U373 is defined. U2744a explicitly supersedes U3734's Pad filtering and U3736's Pad grouping only, because those later clauses otherwise contradict this outcome; ownership and reassignment behavior stay unchanged.

- Amend U2744a and U373's Pads clauses in `scenarios/ui-shelf.md`, then `apps/desktop/src/pads/` (`shownPads.ts`, `Pads.tsx`), `shelf/`, and their tests. Retire scope tests that only Pads used.
- U4457's diamond still opens the Pads tab with that Agent's group expanded and focused (#4477).

Scenarios: U2744a, U373, U4457
Specification: [scenarios/ui-shelf.md](https://github.com/roundup-app/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/ui-shelf.md)
Key: pads-show-all
Priority: 1
Mode: specify

Specification PR: #4580. Implementation stays open in #4579, natively blocked by #4533.

U373 lives in `scenarios/ui-shelf-frame.md`; the validated work-order scope now includes it. The amendment explicitly supersedes U3734's Pad filtering and U3736's owner-only grouping, preserving Todo scope, selected-scope creation and ownership/reassignment calls.

The grouping rule also resolves the diamond's cross-Home destination: a Pad with a Workstream Home and an owner still on the Rail appears in that owner's subgroup inside its Home Workstream, including when its owner lives elsewhere. If the owner has multiple subgroups, the diamond opens ancestors and focuses the first matching subgroup in placement order. The Pad appears once; its Home stays unchanged. No product question remains.
